cards.title: Jonathan Homer Lane
cards.summary: Astrophysicist whose name carries forward to lunar nomenclature.
facts: Associated with early stellar structure theory in public references.
Lane crater naming reflects scientific legacy in lunar cartography.

cards.title: Captain Aaron G. Lane
cards.summary: Mojave River pioneer presented as a Victor Valley settler who established the Lane's Crossing ranch and traveler store in 1859.
facts: Veteran of the Mexican-American War and a Forty-niner in California.
Established the ranch and traveler store at Lane's Crossing on the Mormon Road in San Bernardino County.
Family note: Aaron G. Lane is Homer Lane's first cousin, three times removed.
